page.overview:
Who is Aimee's Family?

Aimee's Family in Fazbear Frights comprises the relatives of Aimee from Find Player Two!, the third story of Fazbear Frights 11: Prankster.

Aimee is the main protagonist of the eleventh Fazbear Frights book's third story.
